name: Talz
description: The Talz were a large furry species with two distinct sets of eyes: one for day vision, and one for night vision. Their homeworld was Alzoc III, a frozen world with much mineral wealth. They also established a colony on the world of Orto Plutonia. Talz were rarely seen in the galaxy away from their homeworld.

data.name: Talz
data.distinctions: Two pairs of eyes, thick light-colored hair
